accepted.label: Bag of Words with scikit-learn's CountVectorizer
accepted.description: Using CountVectorizer from scikit-learn to convert text documents into a term-document matrix of token counts. Students configure parameters such as max_features, n-gram range, and preprocessing options, then apply fit_transform to generate the matrix and interpret the output.
coverage_criteria: Instantiate CountVectorizer with parameters like max_features and fit_transform a list of texts to obtain a sparse matrix.
Explain how parameters (e.g., max_features) control vocabulary size and interpret the resulting term-document matrix.
accepted.merge_rationale: Both candidates teach the identical concept of implementing Bag of Words using scikit-learn's CountVectorizer at the implementation level. They cover instantiation, fit_transform, and parameter tuning (including max_features). Despite minor wording differences and lesson contexts, they represent the same teachable idea and can be assessed with the same questions.
